title: Fix AI model default: gpt-4-turbo-preview → gpt-4o-mini
body: ## Summary The default `AI_MODEL` in `config.py` was set to `gpt-4-turbo-preview` which returns a 404 from OpenAI (`model_not_found`). This caused the AI chat in Build Studio to always fall back to keyword matching instead of using the full conversational AI. Changed the default to `gpt-4o-mini` which works with the current API key. This is a one-line config change. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Open Build Studio chat → type a message → verify the response is conversational (not just "locked in" from the fallback) - [ ] Check browser console (F12) → no more `Build chat AI error: model_not_found` warnings ### Notes - If `AI_MODEL` is set as an env var on Render, that value takes precedence over this default. Make sure it's not set to `gpt-4-turbo-preview` there. - This is the root cause of why the AI path was failing — the personality and error surfacing from PR #102 are working correctly. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/0cf31e0cdff749d89fb8a053b73a1979 Requested by: @letoya-ui ---
